reader_summary.overview: Today, we are exploring the world of media deals. Blake has been in media investment banking for almost two decades. When I first met him, he was a banker, so I wasn't expecting to lean into this relationship.

key_points.text: When I first met him, he was a banker, so I wasn't expecting to lean into this relationship.

Please enjoy this Breakdown of Media with Blake Saunders.
